Callout.Name: Chemical Inhalation
Callout.Message: Worker breathing fumes in a workshop.

Script.Line: One breath. One breath and it went straight into my chest.
Nobody told us what was in the drum. Nobody knows what was in the drum.
I am not going back in there. Do not ask me to go back in there.

Callout.Patient: It went in my chest and stayed there.

Lines.Approach: He is coughing and there is nothing in the air now, which does not mean it has left his lungs.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
